findings.summary: Respect the OS colour preference instead of forcing dark
findings.evidence: Emulated `prefers-color-scheme: light` screenshot compared with default screenshot.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `color-scheme: light dark` and preference-driven light/dark tokens, retaining the current dark palette for dark preference.

findings.summary: Add continuity to multi-step authentication state changes
findings.evidence: Static rendered stylesheet probe reported `viewTransition: false`.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions around email/password/OTP state changes, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Empty primary submission has no visible recovery state
findings.evidence: Interaction screenshot after `form.requestSubmit()` is unchanged; the email input is `type=text`, has no `required`, and remains `aria-invalid=false`.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the field required, validate after interaction, focus it, set `aria-invalid`, and announce a concise error in a live region.

findings.summary: Remove redirect and critical delivery delay
findings.evidence: HAR recorded two 307 redirects; Lighthouse estimated 790 ms redirect savings and 1,040 ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Link and canonicalize the localized login URL directly, inline or minimize critical CSS, and fix font-display/cache/HTTP delivery diagnostics.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 273 KiB unused JavaScript and 13 KiB legacy JavaScript; HAR transferred 704,779 bytes of script.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split provider/reCAPTCHA logic until needed, remove legacy payload for modern browsers, and reduce unused framework chunks.
Resolve the DevTools Inspector issue and remove the reported BFCache blocker so back navigation can restore instantly.

findings.evidence: DOM and Lighthouse both found no meta description; rendered title is only “Spotify”.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a localized title such as “Log in to Spotify” and a concise meta description.

findings.evidence: The successful `/en-GB/login` page has no canonical or hreflang signal, and `/sitemap.xml` returned 404, although robots explicitly allows login routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a canonical for the localized login route and coherent hreflang/sitemap signals, or explicitly noindex the account surface if indexing is not intended.

findings.summary: Harden cookies and CSP on the auth origin
findings.evidence: Cookie audit found `sp_sso_csrf_token` without Secure and `sp_t` with SameSite=None; CSP permits unsafe-inline styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark the CSRF cookie Secure, review the year-long SameSite=None cookie, and remove unsafe-inline style allowance with nonces/hashes where practical.

findings.evidence: DOM exposes email, Google, Facebook and Apple paths; no passkey control is present on this relevant authentication surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey/WebAuthn sign-in and registration alongside existing email and federated methods.

findings.evidence: Headers primitive found both policies absent; HSTS, nosniff and clickjacking protection were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Send a restrictive Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy tailored to the authentication page.

findings.summary: Make the first auth step progressively functional
findings.evidence: Crawler screenshot shows the full form plus “Please enable JavaScript to continue”; discoverability coverage was only 20%.
findings.suggestedFix: Post the basic email form to a server-capable continuation path without JavaScript, then enhance it client-side.

findings.evidence: Empty-submit interaction remained unchanged; DOM shows no `required` attribute and `aria-invalid=false`.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native required semantics plus post-interaction `:user-invalid` styling and an accessible error announcement.

findings.summary: Defer and budget third-party authentication code
findings.evidence: HAR transferred 871,015 bytes total; reCAPTCHA alone was 382,965 bytes, and the tracker probe observed seven third-party origins (none matched known trackers).
findings.suggestedFix: Delay reCAPTCHA/provider code until the relevant interaction where risk controls permit, and enforce a third-party transfer budget.
